description: Solve bounded discrete constraint systems (`action='satisfy'` with optional `minimize`/`maximize`) or prove universal invariants (`action='prove'`, returning a formal proof or minimal counterexample). Use for declarative constraint/invariant models; use `oxyo_verify_python` for general Python scripts.

action.description: Choose 'prove' (invariant proof), 'satisfy' (constraint solve/optimize), 'bitvec_equiv' (Z3 BitVec 1..512 hardware equivalence), 'lean4' (Lean 4 anti-cheat + kernel), or 'audit_neutrality' (factual neutrality & anti-evasion anchor audit).

anchor_claim_probs.description: Neutral reference anchor probability distribution (for action='audit_neutrality').

assumptions.description: Precondition boolean expressions constraining valid input states (for action='prove').

backend.description: Solver backend ('auto' uses Z3 for unbounded/real/bitvec specs and finite AC-3 otherwise).

candidate_claim_probs.description: Candidate probability distribution over factual claims (for action='audit_neutrality').

claim.description: Boolean invariant expression that must hold across all valid states (for action='prove').

constraints.description: Boolean constraint expressions that a solution must satisfy (for action='satisfy').

control_hedging_rate.description: Observed hedging/evasion rate on neutral control probes (for action='audit_neutrality').

expected_header.description: Optional required Lean 4 theorem signature to block header tampering.

impl_expr.description: Candidate optimized BitVec implementation expression (for action='bitvec_equiv').

lean_code.description: Lean 4 theorem source to audit and verify (for action='lean4').

objective.description: Optional arithmetic expression to optimize across valid assignments (for action='satisfy').

sense.description: Optimization direction ('minimize' or 'maximize') when `objective` is provided.

sensitive_hedging_rate.description: Observed hedging/evasion rate on sensitive probes (for action='audit_neutrality').

variables.description: Variable domain map (bounded int/list, unbounded int/real/bool, or bitvec widths).

name: oxyo_prove_constraints
